per_candidate.id: s2:Comparative study of nearly‐grazing and fully‐grazing exoplanet system parameter

rationale: The paper 2203.05460 discusses stellar obliquities (spin-orbit angles) in exoplanetary systems, which is directly relevant to the question regarding the spin-orbit angle Ψ. However, it does not provide new measurements or resolutions to the discrepancies in transit parameters.
